svg.data-throughput: non-blocking 168 Gbps, switching capacity 336 Gbps, forwarding rate 235 Mpps (brochure)
svg.data-port-modes-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ (brochure); the product page's feature badge reads SFP/SFP+, and no module list is printed
svg.data-port-modes-qsfp: 40G QSFP+ (brochure); no module or breakout list is printed
svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, two inputs (redundant supply), 50 - 60 Hz
